They are heterobifunctional molecules designed to bind both a target protein (POI) – such as Tau – and an E3 ubiquitin ligase [HSR2-9-e71631, Chunk_25]. 

Specifically, PROTACs work by forming a ternary complex (PROTAC-POI-E3) [HSR2-9-e71631, Chunk_25]. This brings the target protein into close proximity with the E3 ligase, which then ubiquitinates the target protein [HSR2-9-e71631, Chunk_26].
